title: The Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) Regulations 2009 (S.I. 2009/470) (“the Repayment Regulations”) which make provision for the repayment of income-contingent student loans in England and Wales.

title: The County Courts (Financial Limits) Order (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: This Order increases the general civil jurisdiction of county courts in Northern Ireland from £30,000 to £60,000, increases the general civil jurisdiction of county courts to hear any action claiming damages in respect of libel or slander from £3,000 to £10,000 and increases the jurisdiction of district judges in the county courts from £10,000 to £20,000.

title: The Air Departure Tax (Scotland) Amendment Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Air Departure Tax (Scotland) Act 2017 (“the 2017 Act”) to make provision concerning who is a non-chargeable passenger in respect of certain flights which begin or end at an airport in a designated area of Scotland and related consequential amendments to the 2017 Act. In addition, these Regulations amend section 9 of the 2017 Act (aircraft used under public service obligation).
